append.detail: 2026-11-10: cause narrowed. SiteRoot rendered the SCAN-895 pre-paint script only when the resolved page was unlocked, so an ISR page regenerated under a pathname that resolved to the locked fallback differed structurally from the client's Home render (#418). The script is now always rendered (it skips a locked root itself) and an effect writes the client's page attributes after mount. The trigger that made a regeneration see a non-'/' pathname is still unknown; reopen if #418 recurs on /.
